column1: # Every direct call to the engine setting getters in F1_25.exe build d873a1c8d2044cef (KB build), found by a capstone scan of
# E8/E9 rel32 references to the getters in both code sections, .xtls and .data1 (88 sites, among them the talking points state's
# reader of Game.SkipTalkingPoints at 0x14eb3ac2a). name: the C string in rdx (empty when rdx is not a rip-relative literal); default:
# the immediate in r9 or the float constant in xmm3 at the call, else the register or memory it came from (the reader passes its
# previous value). These are code defaults; system/config.xml, config_platform.xml and config_sku.xml in game.dat may set any of them.
# getter: bool Ne_Get_SettingBool 0x143a43b90, u32 Ne_Get_SettingU32 0x143a43240, i32 Ne_Map_FindOrDefaultWithErrorContext
# 0x143a42f10, float Ne_Config_GetFloatOrDefault 0x143a44090, double Ne_Get_SettingDouble 0x143a43ea0, string Ne_Config_GetString
# 0x143a44700, string_set Ne_Config_GetStringWithDefault 0x143a44280. Evidence L1 per row (static scan, call site and literal only).
# retail: the value system/config.xml, then config_platform.xml, then config_sku.xml give the name (the later file wins), read from
# game.dat of the installed build (F1_25.exe sha256 46009bd3..., game.dat 170,184,448 bytes) with packages/formats NeFS; empty when
# none of the three sets it, so the code default applies. Names compare case-insensitively.
